trial_balance.empty_body: Upload the trial balance from Luca (.xlsx or .csv); each period shows up here.
reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: {{period}}: the trial balance against the portal's sources by account, counterparty and BA/BS reconciliation.
reconciliation.no_trial_balance: No trial balance with amounts is uploaded for {{period}}. Upload it on the account plan screen first.
reconciliation.empty_title: This period is not compared yet
reconciliation.empty: After uploading the {{period}} trial balance, use “Compare” to check it against invoices, bank, expenses, Z reports and payroll.
reconciliation.cumulative: cumulative from January (no earlier trial balance)
reconciliation.accounts_empty: Every account matches its sources or has a decision.
reconciliation.detail_hint: Entry amounts by source kind, unposted records and sub accounts.
reconciliation.no_sources: No journal line was posted to this account.
reconciliation.no_unposted: No unposted record affects this account.
reconciliation.send_review_hint: The explanation becomes a suggestion in the queue; accepting it resolves the difference.
reconciliation.counterparty_hint: The ledger balance comes from the 120 / 320 account in the counterparty memory, the portal balance from invoices and matched payments. Positive means the counterparty owes.
reconciliation.babs_hint: Form BA / BS lines filed (or to be filed) for {{period}}. The comparison checks them against the invoice totals (VAT excluded, 5,000 TL limit).
reconciliation.import_failed: The file could not be read.
reconciliation.babs_empty: Upload the BA/BS listing from the accounting program or the tax portal.
reconciliation.letters_hint: Balance confirmation letters sent and the counterparties' answers. The response link works for 60 days.
reconciliation.pdf_failed: The PDF could not be opened.
reconciliation.letters_empty: Send a balance confirmation letter to a counterparty from the counterparty view.
tax_returns.title: Tax returns
tax_returns.description: VAT (KDV1), withholding and social security (MUHSGK) and Ba/Bs returns in the form's layout: checklist, preparation, filing record and Excel export.
tax_returns.frozen_hint: Snapshot taken when prepared; later data changes are not reflected.
tax_returns.open_warnings: {{count}} warnings must be acknowledged before preparing.
tax_returns.accrual_missing: Not attached. Add the accrual PDF you got from GİB.
tax_returns.accrual_failed: Could not attach the accrual slip. Only a PDF (up to 10 MB) can be attached.
tax_returns.accrual_download_failed: Could not download the accrual slip.
tax_returns.export_failed: Could not download the Excel file.
tax_returns.checklist_empty: No open items for this period.
tax_returns.kdv1_special: Supplies with a special tax base
tax_returns.kdv1_purchases: Deductible VAT of the period — by rate
tax_returns.adjust_hint: Adjustments: an empty field uses the computed value. A carried-in VAT entered here replaces the previous return's.
tax_returns.adjust_invalid: Amounts must be 0 or more with at most two decimals.
tax_returns.muhsgk_empty: No payments with withholding this period.
tax_returns.employees_empty: No payroll was uploaded for this period.
tax_returns.babs_hint: Documents are reported for each counterparty whose total excluding VAT reaches the threshold. Threshold:
tax_returns.history_empty: Returns appear here once a draft is saved or a return is prepared.
related.title: Related records
related.description: Payments, journals, warnings and review records linked to this record.
related.empty: No other record is linked to this one.
related.load_error: Related records could not be loaded.
related.focus_edge: No more records in this direction.
luca_plan.title: Luca account plan file
luca_plan.description: The CSV for Luca's "Hesap Planı Aktar" screen. New caris are not opened by hand in Luca; the portal makes their sub account codes.
luca_plan.unverified: Format not verified in Luca. Columns, delimiter (;), Windows-1254 encoding and line endings come from another team's observation of the Luca screen; do the first upload on a test taxpayer.
luca_plan.generated: {{created}} new sub accounts opened, {{existing}} caris already had a code.
luca_plan.error_NO_NEW_ACCOUNTS: Luca has every account; no file needed.
luca_plan.error_NO_FREE_CODE: No free sub account code left under the main account.
luca_plan.error_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING: An account has no code or name; no file was made.
bank.luca.title: Luca bank statement (CSV)
bank.luca.description: The account's movements in the date range, as a CSV for Luca's "Banka Aktarımı (Excel/CSV)" / "Banka Ekstreleri" screen.
bank.luca.unverified: Format not verified in Luca. Columns, date (dd.mm.yyyy) and decimal (comma) format and Windows-1254 encoding come from another team's observation of the Luca screen; do the first import on a test taxpayer.
bank.luca.no_account: This taxpayer has no bank account.
bank.luca.repeated: Note: {{count}} movements of the file were exported to Luca before. Check they are not booked twice in Luca.
bank.luca.guide_title: Statement definition in Luca: step by step
bank.luca.guide_description: The accountant sets this definition up once in Luca; later files use the same definition.
bank.luca.step_open: In Luca open a new statement definition on the "Banka Ekstreleri" screen (screen name from the observation).
bank.luca.step_header: Tick "take the header from the CSV"; the first row holds the column names.
bank.luca.step_format: Delimiter: {{delimiter}}, quote: {{quote}}, currency: the file's Döviz column.
bank.luca.step_columns: Pick each column's fiş sütunu and data type as in the table below.
bank.luca.step_save: Save the definition and import the downloaded CSV with it.
bank.luca.sign_signed: Signed amount: money in plus (+), money out minus (−).
bank.luca.sign_two_columns: Borç: money out; Alacak: money in (as on the statement).
bank.luca.error_NO_TRANSACTIONS: The account has no movements in the range.
bank.luca.error_VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the dates (at most 366 days, start before end).
bank.luca.error_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING: A movement has no date or amount; no file was made.
change_requests.title: {{count}} change requests for locked periods
change_requests.hint: A new or changed invoice arrived for a closed period. The record was not changed; review the difference and apply or reject it.
change_requests.new_invoice: A new invoice for the locked period; applying adds it to the period.
change_requests.reject_done: Request rejected; the record is unchanged.
change_requests.stale: This request no longer applies (already decided or a newer source arrived).
tax_returns.blocking_none: No open warnings left for this period.
bank.matching.not_matchable: This movement is not a collection or a payment (interest, tax, transfer…); it is not matched to invoices. Assign its ledger account in the bank account matching instead.
bank.matching.no_candidates: No open invoice with a matching date and amount. Search below by invoice no, name or tax id.
bank.matching.matched: Movement matched to the invoice; bank warnings refreshed.
bank.matching.unmatched: Match undone; the movement is back under Unmatched. Match it to another invoice or book it to an account below.
tax_returns.blocking_hint: Problems are grouped by record. Use "Open and fix" to open the record without leaving this screen; the list and the return update as you fix.
tax_returns.panel_hint: Fix the record here or decide on its warnings; the return is recalculated automatically.
tax_returns.panel_no_warnings: No open warnings left on this record.
warning_decision.placeholder: E.g. the difference comes from the contract and is correct
warning_decision.acknowledge_hint: The warning is right but knowingly accepted; a reason is asked.
warning_decision.resolve_hint: The record was fixed; say what was done. Fixing the record usually closes the warning by itself.
warning_sheet.hint: Fix the record here, then close it with a reason. Use ← → to move between warnings.
warning_decision.preset_checked: Compared with the document; the record is correct.
warning_decision.preset_correction_reque: A correcting or cancelling invoice was requested from the taxpayer.
warning_decision.preset_rounding: Rounding difference of a few kuruş; no effect on the return.
warning_decision.preset_duplicate_keep: Not a duplicate: two separate invoices, both valid.
warning_decision.preset_duplicate_cancel: Duplicate: one will be cancelled at the source; a single invoice goes to the return.
warning_code_fix.title: Fix the line's account code
warning_code_fix.label: Correct account code
warning_request.title: Missing document {{period}}
warning_request.error: Document request could not be sent
warning_sheet.invoice_hint: The invoice comes from its source (e-invoice / e-archive), so it cannot be changed here. If it is wrong, ask the taxpayer for a correcting or cancelling invoice; if you compared it with the document and it is right, close the warning with your reason.
warning_sheet.transactions_hint: Open each movement and settle it: match its invoice or book it to an account. The warning closes by itself once all are settled.
warning_sheet.transactions_more: {{count}} more movements; see the rest on the taxpayer's Bank screen.
expense_view.title: Expense
expense_view.decide_hint: Deciding closes the "unapproved expense" warning by itself.
zreport_view.title: Z report
zreport_view.load_failed: Could not load the Z report.
zreport_view.save_failed: Could not save the Z report
zreport_view.edit_hint: If the number or date was misread, fix it here; the warning closes by itself. If a report is really missing, ask the taxpayer for it.
zreport_view.locked_hint: An approved or rejected report cannot be changed here.
privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.description: Requests about the taxpayer's personal data: export or erasure. An office owner or admin approves them.
privacy.forbidden: Seeing privacy requests needs a permission. Ask your office admin.
privacy.kind_export_hint: The taxpayer's personal data in the system is prepared as a file.
privacy.kind_erasure_hint: Personal data is deleted or anonymised. Accounting records are kept for the legal period. This cannot be undone.
privacy.reason_placeholder: E.g. the taxpayer's written request of 12.11.2026
privacy.create_hint: No data changes until the request is approved.
privacy.empty: No privacy request has been opened for this taxpayer.
privacy.approve_export_body: The taxpayer's personal data is prepared as a downloadable file. It can be downloaded for a limited time; every download is logged.
privacy.approve_erasure_body: The taxpayer's users are anonymised, their sessions and devices deleted and their links to the taxpayer removed. Accounting records are kept for the legal period. This cannot be undone.
privacy.reject_body: A reason is required and is shown on the request.
privacy.already_decided: This request has already been decided
privacy.download_failed: Could not download; the file may have expired
review_override.title: Approval threshold for this taxpayer
review_override.auto: Auto-accept when confidence is above the threshold
review_override.hint: For a risky or new taxpayer raise the threshold or turn auto-accept off; every suggestion then goes to review.
excel.title: Excel import
excel.description: Bring in an Excel or CSV export from another program: invoices, payroll, expenses, Z reports or bank movements. Columns are mapped, rows are checked and written on your approval.
excel.forbidden: Seeing Excel imports needs a permission. Ask your office admin.
excel.upload_hint: xlsx or csv, up to 20 MB. For payroll, enter the period here if the file does not name it (e.g. 2026-10).
excel.empty: No Excel import has been made for this taxpayer yet.
excel.step_working: The file is being processed; it will be ready shortly.
excel.step_mapping: Check which field each column goes to, then save.
excel.step_rows: Some rows have errors. Skip them or fix the column mapping.
excel.step_ready: Validation is clean. On approval the rows are written.
excel.ai_used: Columns were mapped by AI; please check.
excel.result: {{added}} records added; {{duplicates}} rows already existed, {{rejected}} rows were refused.
excel.save_template: Keep as a template for this taxpayer
excel.duplicate_fields: The same field is mapped to several columns: {{fields}}
excel.rows_hint: Once the rows with errors are skipped the import is ready to write.
excel.commit_title: Write this import to the records?
excel.commit_body: {{count}} rows will be written; {{skipped}} rows will be skipped. Rows already recorded are not added twice.
excel.rollback_body: The invoices this import added are deleted; ones that existed before are left alone. Only invoice imports roll back.
excel.rollback_not_supported: This data type cannot be rolled back here; fix the records in their own screen.
excel.templates_empty: No saved template. Tick "keep as a template" when saving a mapping.
excel.template_delete_body: Files with the same layout will be mapped again from now on. Finished imports are not affected.
bank.matching.search_placeholder: Search by invoice no, name or tax id
bank.matching.search_hint: Not in the list? Search: open invoices are found even when the date or amount differs (partial, late or combined payment).
bank.matching.search_empty: No open invoice matches. If the invoice has not arrived, request it from the taxpayer; if the payment has no invoice, post the movement with an account code in the period's bank entry.
bank.matching.account_none: This movement is not booked to an account yet.
bank.matching.account_drafted_hint: The movement is in a journal entry. Reverse the entry first to change the account.
bank.matching.account_search: Search account: code or name (e.g. 320 or a counterparty)
bank.matching.account_hint: If there is no invoice, book the movement to an account here: counterparty (120/320), advance (159/340), salary, tax, social security, rent, bank charges. The decision stays in the review queue and can be reverted there.
bank.matching.account_empty: No account in the chart matches. Type the full account code (e.g. 320.01.015) to book to that code.
bank.matching.account_custom: Not in the chart; book to this code
bank.matching.account_saved: Movement booked to {{code}}; bank warnings refreshed.
bank.matching.history_empty: No manual action on this movement yet.
bank.matching.history_failed: Could not load the movement history.
balance_check.title: Statement balance check
balance_check.empty: No bank movements in this period; the statement may not be uploaded.
balance_check.off: The statement's closing balance does not match the movements: a missing day, a duplicate or a cancelled movement. Get the statement again and upload it; resolve the warning with a reason once the difference is gone.
balance_check.no_balance: The statement has no balance column, so it cannot be checked. Upload a statement with balances (MT940 or the bank's Excel).
balance_check.ok: The balance matches the movements. You can resolve the warning with a reason.
review_api.ocr_rationale: Document reading is {{pct}}% sure of this field; compare it with the document and confirm.
journals.check.unknown_account: Line {{line}}: {{account}} is not in the account plan
journals.check.parent_account: Line {{line}}: {{account}} is a parent account; pick a sub-account
journals.check.period_locked: The period is closed; reopen it to approve
journals.check.unlock_prompt: The period is locked (approved). Write why it is being opened; the reason is kept in the period's lock history. Once open, this entry can be approved.
journals.check.unlock_no_permission: You may not open the period; ask the accountant in charge.
journals.check.fix_description: Enter the sub-account code from the plan (e.g. 770.01). Now: {{account}}
journals.check.approve_blocked: Fix the issues first; a blocked entry is not approved.
journals.check.approve_clean_description: Entries without a blocking issue are approved and ready to transfer; account warnings are checked again before export. {{blocked}} blocked entries stay as drafts.
journals.check.summary: {{drafts}} drafts · {{blocked}} to look at, {{stopped}} cannot be approved
journals.error_JOURNAL_BLOCKED: The entry has issues to fix; see the Check column.
picker.search: Search by name or tax ID
review.correct_unavailable: This suggestion type has no value to change; approve or reject it.
review.receipt_image_failed: The photo could not be loaded.
review.correct_unavailable_bank_match: A match cannot be changed here. If it is wrong, reject it; open the movement on the Bank screen and match the right invoice or book it to an account.
review.value_hint_text: Write it as it appears on the document.
journals.export_scope_selected: Only the {{count}} approved entries selected in the table are exported.
journals.export_scope_period: All approved entries of the period are exported. Select entries in the table to export only some.
tax_returns.office.description: {{period}} filing period: each taxpayer's KDV1, MUHSGK and Ba/Bs status, documents expected from the taxpayer and open blockers. Click a row to open the taxpayer's returns.
tax_returns.office.summary: {{total}} taxpayers · KDV1: {{filed}} filed, {{prepared}} prepared, {{open}} not prepared · documents expected for {{documents}}
tax_returns.office.due_rolled: (moved to Monday because of the weekend)
tax_returns.office.statement_requested: Statement requested; added to the taxpayer's tasks.
tax_returns.office.statement_request_not: We need the statement with all of the month's movements (PDF, Excel or MT940). You can download it from internet banking and upload it.
journals.transfer_check_ok: Luca trial balance matches the records
journals.transfer_check_stale: Trial balance was compared before this transfer
journals.transfer_check_none: Not compared with the trial balance
journals.entry.account_not_in_plan: Not in the chart of accounts
journals.entry.amount_invalid: The amount on line {{line}} can't be read (e.g. 1.250,50).
journals.entry.line_incomplete: Line {{line}} needs an account and only a debit or a credit amount.
journals.entry.no_lines: Enter an account and an amount on at least one line.
journals.entry.keyboard_hint: Search by account code or name. Enter moves to the next field and opens a new line at the end; Ctrl+Enter saves the draft.
transfers.title: Program transfers
transfers.description: Approved entries of every taxpayer that have not reached the accounting program (Luca, Zirve) yet, and the trial balance check of the latest transfers. Click a row to open the taxpayer's journals for that period.
transfers.pending_description: Taxpayers and periods with approved entries that have not been transferred to the program. Exports that were only downloaded are not counted.
transfers.pending_summary: {{entries}} entries in {{periods}} taxpayer periods have not reached the program. Exports that were only downloaded are not counted.
transfers.pending_empty: No approved entries are waiting for transfer.
transfers.recent_description: The latest transfer of each export. For transferred ones, whether the period's trial balance was compared with the records and any differences.
transfers.recent_empty: No transfers to the program yet.
